scripts.typecheck: tsc -p core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p cli/tsconfig.json && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p renderer/tsconfig.json
scripts.desktop:build: npm run renderer:build && npm run build -w @herdr-bot/desktop
scripts.desktop:start: npm run desktop:build && npm run start -w @herdr-bot/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build -w @herdr-bot/desktop && HERDR_BOT_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 HERDR_BOT_DEV=1 npm run start -w @herdr-bot/desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run desktop:build && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --project desktop
scripts.desktop:package:dir: npm run desktop:build && npx electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --project desktop --dir
scripts.tauri:frontend:dev: node scripts/build-native-cli.mjs debug && npm run dev -w renderer -- --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.tauri:frontend:build: node scripts/build-native-cli.mjs release && npm run renderer:build
